Plugin.Name: Swarm View
Plugin.Overview: Docker Swarm on the Unraid Docker page. A "Swarm Stacks" section like Compose Manager lets you create, edit and deploy stack files; Unraid's container list shows on which node each container runs and lists containers on other nodes (e.g. a Raspberry Pi) with CPU/RAM, network, uptime, logs and actions. Choose per service where it runs - automatically, preferred node with failover and automatic return, or fixed. Optional notifications, update hints with rollback, cleanup of stopped task containers and a settings page with node warnings. Requires an active Swarm with Unraid as manager. Works with Folder View.
